verdict.rationale: The evidence describes a Fetch-style capability that converts a URL to HTML, JSON or markdown, plus 'auto-waits' within full browser control. Neither documents a parameter that makes the API wait for a specific selector before returning the rendered page. Auto-waits during interactive browser sessions are a related control and a developer building block, not this capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have the API wait for a specific selector to appear before returning the rendered page
